content:
INRM Consultants’ Director, Prof. Ashvani Gosain was one of the Distinguished Panelist and gave a presentation for the Integrated Water Management for Climate-Resilient and Water-Secure Future held on 20th August, 2026 at Pragati Maidan, New Delhi organised by TERI School of Advanced Studies.

The conference provided a valuable interdisciplinary platform to explore scientific advances, innovative technologies, policy frameworks, and successful case studies in climate-resilient water management. Prof. Gosain’s presentation emphasised the need for adaptive and climate-resilient water planning, integrating scenario-based modelling, demand management, groundwater recharge, and real-time monitoring, while highlighting the importance of basin-level coordination, shared data systems, and joint accountability among water-related institutions.

comment: A key challenge will be translating basin-level strategies into local implementation, where fragmented data, institutional incentives, and community participation often determine whether resilience plans succeed.
